notes: 92/92 grep hits across the six NURBS files are accounted for by exactly one row each: 20 model, 49 param, 23 excluded (17 doc comments, 6 squared-order near2 sites). 25 distinct functions carry a production predicate site; make_locally_injective and search_nearest_parameter appear only via doc-comment hits and carry no production predicates. All 92 hits fit the model/param/excluded trichotomy, so there is no SPEC_GAP: the nearest3-edge cases are the near2 knot sites in syncro_knots/syncro_uvknots and the near2_as_curve/surface closures, all of which the packet pre-classifies as squared-order excluded even though the underlying quantities (knots, points) are otherwise cleanly param/model, and the six doc-comment hits, excluded as not code. No site required low confidence; the physically decisive reading is unambiguous in every case. Findings beyond the inventory: (1) not_in_inventory names functions with production sites the census table did not list -- sub_near_as_curve (bspcurve 235), sub_near_as_surface (bspsurface 523,530), near2_as_curve (bspcurve 951, nurbscurve 229), near2_as_surface (bspsurface 1608, nurbssurface 358); (2) the blind-spot grep for _TOLERANCE/TOLERANCE_/TOLERANCE*TOLERANCE across the eight files returned nothing, so no missed constant exists here; (3) sectional_curve lines 1277/1280 compare p[0]/q[0] (the u-coordinate of the parameter-space sectioning box) against vknots -- apparently a typo for p[1]/q[1], but the quantity is a parameter either way so the classification is unaffected; (4) inv_or_zero is a const fn, so applying its proposed rewrite requires threading a ctx or making the fn non-const; (5) derivation and vderivation were listed by the census but contain no direct tolerance-predicate lines -- their comparisons live inside inv_or_zero, which is classified at mod.rs 186.
